{
  "candidate_rtl": "module comparator_16bit (
    input [15:0] A,
    input [15:0] B,
    output gt,
    output eq,
    output lt
);
    wire [3:0] block_eq;
    wire [3:0] block_gt;

    genvar k;
    generate
        for (k = 0; k < 4; k = k + 1) begin : blocks
            assign block_eq[k] = (A[4*k +: 4] == B[4*k +: 4]);
            assign block_gt[k] = (A[4*k +: 4] > B[4*k +: 4]);
        end
    endgenerate

    assign eq = &block_eq;
    assign gt = block_gt[3] |
                (block_eq[3] & block_gt[2]) |
                (block_eq[3] & block_eq[2] & block_gt[1]) |
                (block_eq[3] & block_eq[2] & block_eq[1] & block_gt[0]);
    assign lt = ~(gt | eq);
endmodule",
  "bottleneck": "The previous candidate's equality output was critical at 0.77 ns, and its measured 689.4112 um2 area exceeded the specified 547.775360 um2 cap. Its separate block-level less-than network also consumed logic and added loading.",
  "rewrite": "Retain four parallel unsigned 4-bit comparisons and a lookahead combination across blocks. Express local comparisons directly so synthesis can optimize their carry/borrow logic rather than imposing per-bit XNOR propagation. Remove the entire block-level less-than network and derive lt from the mutually exclusive global gt and eq results.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Targets reduced local comparison complexity and fanout while retaining a shallow block-lookahead path. The final NOR on lt may become critical. No mapped timing result is available for this revision, so improvement over 0.77 ns is not established.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Eliminates four local less-than results and their global priority-combination network. This targets a substantial area reduction from the previous candidate; compliance with the area cap and zero electrical violations still requires mapped evaluation.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves the module name, all ports, unsigned 16-bit operands, and combinational behavior. For every binary input pair, gt indicates A>B, eq indicates A==B, and lt indicates A<B. The identity lt=~(gt|eq) is exact for these unsigned binary comparisons. No parameters, state, latency, assumptions, or external dependencies are introduced."
}
